main.description: Reserve a KEM key, for use with account creation. Its public key is published as the account's #atproto_kem verification method, which is used to establish shared secrets for spaces. Necessary so that a DID PLC operation can be constructed before the account exists. Counterpart to com.atproto.server.reserveSigningKey. Implemented by PDS.

did.description: The DID to reserve a key for.

kemKey.description: The public key for the reserved KEM key, in did:key serialization.
